title: Redesign Projects dashboard to match uploaded reference (GENESIS.ENGINE style) while keeping existing project actions

requirements.text: Redesign the Projects dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx) to fully replace the current layout and visual style to match the uploaded reference (image-42.png) and the referenced video, while preserving existing project functionality (create, open, edit/settings, delete).

quotes: Redesign and adjust the Project Management page to match the layout, flow, and interaction style shown in the attached reference video, image.
1. follow the uploaded image and video
2. new layout fully replace the current Projects dashboard, but the functions remain the same.

acceptanceCriteria: The dashboard route/view still shows the list of projects and supports: create project, open project, edit project settings, and delete project (same callbacks/behavior as before).
The page header/hero area visually matches the reference: large typographic wordmark treatment, subdued supporting copy, and an overall dark, minimal, high-contrast aesthetic.
Project cards are redesigned to match the reference card style: large rounded tiles, subtle borders/shadows, subdued secondary text, and hover-driven emphasis.

A dedicated 'Start new project' tile exists in the grid as a dashed-outline/placeholder style tile with a centered plus icon and label similar to the reference, and triggers the existing create-project dialog when clicked.

Card content matches the reference’s intent by showing key project fields in the card (at minimum: blockchain/protocol tag, project name, unit count/collection size, and an initialized/created date derived from createdAt).
Per-card actions for settings/edit and delete remain available and do not trigger open-project when clicked (stopPropagation preserved).
Animations/interactions are updated to match the reference’s flow: subtle fade/scale in on load and a clear hover state on tiles without harming performance or accessibility.
All user-facing strings introduced/modified by this redesign are in English.

requirements.text: Update the create-project and project-settings dialogs used from the dashboard to visually match the new Projects dashboard style (dark, minimal, rounded, subdued borders), without changing their underlying validation logic or data shape.

quotes: Redesign and adjust the Project Management page to match the layout, flow, and interaction style shown in the attached reference video, image.
2. new layout fully replace the current Projects dashboard, but the functions remain the same.

acceptanceCriteria: The New Project dialog still creates a project with the same fields and defaults as before and navigates into the project as before.
The Project settings dialog still edits name, symbol, collection size, and pixel art mode as before.
Dialog styling (background, borders, typography, spacing, control shapes) is consistent with the redesigned dashboard and uses existing shadcn components (composed, not modified in-place).

requirements.text: Ensure the redesigned Projects dashboard layout is responsive and preserves usability across breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop), matching the reference grid feel (large tiles, generous spacing) while keeping the existing header/navigation behavior intact.

quotes: Redesign and adjust the Project Management page to match the layout, flow, and interaction style shown in the attached reference video, image.
2. new layout fully replace the current Projects dashboard, but the functions remain the same.

acceptanceCriteria: On small screens, tiles stack cleanly (1 column) and the hero/header typography scales down without overflow or clipping.
On medium/large screens, tiles present as a grid similar to the reference with consistent gaps and alignment.
No changes are required to frontend/src/components/Header.tsx behavior; navigating into/out of projects remains unchanged.

constraints: Do not remove or change the existing project actions/callbacks wired from App.tsx (onCreateProject, onOpenProject, onUpdateProject, onDeleteProject).

Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep the app as a single-page React app; no new routes/framework changes.
Use English for any user-facing text introduced or modified.
nonGoals: Implementing new backend storage or changing the Motoko backend.
Adding new project fields beyond what is already stored (aside from deriving display fields like initialized date from createdAt).
Changing non-dashboard pages’ layouts beyond what is necessary for shared visual consistency of dialogs invoked from the dashboard.
